# Juan Manuel's cipher (1522), imperial ambassador to Rome, letters to Emperor Charles V. Reconstruction:
# Satoshi Tomokiyo, Cryptiana (cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/AlonsoSanchez.htm, section "Juan Manuel's Cipher (1522)"),
# mainly from the first page of the contemporary decipherment attached to DECODE record R9528 ("cipher is similar
# to Alonso Sanchez's"). Archive: BRAH, Coleccion Salazar (R9499-R9529 in DECODE). Parsed 27 Sept 2026.
# office: Juan Manuel (imperial ambassador, Rome) -> Charles V
# design: substitution alphabet + nomenclator (word -> code, similar system to Alonso Sanchez's cipher)
# note: whole table is Tomokiyo's own cryptanalytic reconstruction from one letter's decipherment (grade M
# throughout per this job's brief); his own '?'/'??'/'???' and [bracket] marks carried into the note column.
